UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
EXAMINATION NOTICE NO. 01/2026-ENGG
Date of Notice: 05 January 2026

Engineering Services Examination 2026

Candidates to ensure their eligibility for the examination:

. Minimum Educational Qualification: Degree in Engineering (B.E./B. Tech) from a recognized University.

. Age Limits: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have attained the age of 30 years on 0
. Fee: Candidates are required to pay a fee of Rs. 200 (SC/ST/PwBD and Women candidates exempted).

. Last Date for Submission of Applications: 18 February 2026 till 6.00 PM.

. Required Documents: Matriculation Certificate, Degree Certificate, Photo ID.

. Online Portal: https://upsconline.nic.in

. Facilitation Counter Phone: 011-23385271
